letters.title: Letters
letters.description: Numbered outgoing letters with a QR signature anyone can verify, plus a register of incoming letters and their dispositions.
letters.subject: Subject
letters.loadError: Letters could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
letters.emptyOutgoingBody: Compose a letter from a template, preview it on paper, then sign it with a QR code anyone can verify.
letters.emptyIncomingBody: Record letters the school receives, along with their dispositions, so they are easy to track.
letters.emptyFilteredBody: Change the keywords, date range, or status to see other letters.
letters.noManage: You do not have permission to compose or edit letters.
letters.composeDescription: Pick a template, fill in the details, and watch the letter take shape on A4 paper as you type.
letters.templateEmptyHint: No templates yet. Install the default templates under Letter templates.
letters.studentNoAccess: You cannot search students; the letter can still be written without student data.
letters.recipientHint: E.g. Parent or guardian of Ahmad Fauzan
letters.previewNote: The letter number is generated when the draft is saved. Marks like «…» show data not filled in yet.
letters.onlyDraftEditable: Only outgoing drafts can be edited.
letters.paperEmpty: The letter body will appear here.
letters.qrCaption: Scan to verify this letter is authentic.

letters.notASignerHint: You are not registered as a signer. Ask a letter manager to add you under Signers.
letters.signedPdfFailed: The letter is signed, but the PDF could not be created. Use the Download PDF button.
letters.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be created. Try again.
letters.reprintDiffers: The PDF was regenerated and is not identical to the file made at signing, so file matching on the verification page only works for the PDF downloaded first.
letters.revokeBody: The verification page will show the letter as revoked, with the reason. This cannot be undone.
letters.deleteBody: A deleted draft cannot be restored.
letters.linkCopyFailed: Could not copy the link. Copy it manually from the box.
letters.incomingDescription: The register number is generated automatically. Enter the sender's own number if there is one.
letters.dispositionHint: Notes and destination, e.g. "Forward to the Vice Principal for Curriculum for follow-up".
letters.signersDescription: Officials entitled to sign letters. Each person's signature is kept private and only used when they sign.
letters.signerFormDescription: A signer is linked to one school member, who creates their own signature.
letters.memberNoAccess: The member list could not be loaded.
letters.signerDeleteBody: A signer who has already signed letters cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.
letters.signersEmptyBody: Add the principal or another official so letters can be signed.
letters.mySignatureHint: Used on letters you sign as {name}.
letters.notASigner: You are not registered as a signer. Ask a letter manager to add you so you can create a signature.
letters.uploadHint: PNG or JPG; automatically shrunk to at most 150 KB.
letters.signatureTooLarge: The image cannot be shrunk to {kb} KB. Use a simpler image.
letters.removeSignatureBody: Future letters will be signed without a signature image.
letters.signaturePrivacy: Your signature image is private: only you can see it, and it only appears on letters you sign for {school}.
letters.templatesDescription: Letter and certificate layouts with data placeholders such as {{nama}} and {{kelas}} that fill in automatically.
letters.templateFormDescription: Write the letter; click a chip to insert a placeholder at the cursor.
letters.templateActive: Template is active (can be chosen when composing)
letters.templateDeleteBody: A template already used by letters cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
letters.samplePreviewNote: Uses sample data; real letters are filled from student and signer data.
letters.templatesEmptyBody: Install the three default templates (student certificate, parent summons, and a simple certificate), then adapt them as you like.

verify.loadErrorTitle: Verification is not available right now
verify.loadErrorBody: The server could not be reached or there were too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
verify.statusBody_valid: This letter was issued and signed by the issuing school and has not been revoked.
verify.statusBody_revoked: This letter was once valid, but its issuer has revoked it and it must no longer be relied on.
verify.statusBody_unknown: This code does not match any document issued through Edusync.
verify.subject: Subject
verify.unknownHint: Make sure you scanned the QR code printed on the original letter. If the code is right, contact the issuing school.
verify.matchBody: Have the PDF? Choose it to confirm it is exactly what was signed. The file is checked in your browser and is not uploaded.
verify.checkError: The check failed. Try again shortly.
verify.matchYesBody: This file is identical to the signed document. It has not been altered.
verify.matchNoBody: This file differs from the signed document. It may have been altered, or it is not the original PDF.
verify.matchNoHash: The issuer has not registered a file fingerprint for this letter, so the file cannot be matched.
verify.disclaimer: This is a simple signature (QR code and file fingerprint), not a certified electronic signature.
